content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the stalls for tostadas, fresh fruit, and the hum of Coyoacán life."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb to the castle for sweeping views and a crash course in Mexico's imperial past."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stroll the leafy streets of Roma and let the facades and cafés set the pace."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The great stone calendar and the Aztec halls will anchor your whole trip."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A soft green wander past the lake and the castle hill, easy on landing-day legs."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tacos al pastor made from plants, with salsa that wakes you up gently."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The Zócalo hums with centuries of stories, perfect for a slow first wander."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Templo Mayor's ruins whisper the old Aztec heart of the city."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lalo! serves bright, veg-friendly plates in a lively, casual room."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bellas Artes glows with murals and that golden dome worth a photo."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Xochimilco's painted boats drift through canals that feel a world away."}]}
A gentle landing among the trees, then the old heart and its canals, ending in Coyoacán's colors — every must-do tucked in, amiguito.
